# rustinion_on_call_override (Resource)

Manages a time-bounded on-call override: a user covers instead of whoever the rotation math would otherwise pick, for [starts_at, ends_at). See on_call.rs in the main repo. Every attribute forces replacement — there is no in-place update, matching the server's own create/delete-only API for overrides.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the override ends at. Must be after starts_at — rejected server-side otherwise.
- `schedule_id` (String) ID of the on-call schedule this override applies to.
- `starts_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the override begins at.
- `user_id` (String) User covering for this window.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned override ID.
